scope: One warm 513x259 RGBA8 to 4:4:4 JPEG pair; source alpha flattened once on 0x204060. Single CPU. Uniform <=2x is not established.
inputProvenance: Existing HorizontalFlipInput.Create(8), OriginalPixels.Generate, phase zero with zero alpha at first-row ends and hidden RGB retained. One original source raster, no external corpus.
changedPrimitive: Forward DCT only: safe AVX-512 eight-frequency or AVX four-frequency lanes; unchanged frozen binary64 basis, two separate multiplications, y/x accumulation order, 4096 logical work units and scalar fallback. No new table, buffer, dependency, image cache or unsafe code.

quietnessBefore.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

baseline.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent JPEG bytes: explicit single-round alpha flattening on 0x204060, full-range BT.601 conversion, 4:4:4 encode, output acquisition/release. Native codec/conversion/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused, but pixels are flattened/converted and encoded every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray. Native optimal Huffman and managed fixed Huffman recorded. Quality matched by frozen <=0.25 dB RGB source-error band; fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.
